turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
Hello, I can help with a delivery address change. Please send me the order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with, and tell me the new address you want.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.

Thank you, Nora. I checked order SC-3360, and it has already shipped. Under our policy, the delivery address can only be changed until the order ships, so I can't change it now. You can follow the parcel with the tracking link at https://curier.example/track/SC3360. If you need more help, I can pass you to a colleague.

Ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba doar până la expedierea comenzii. Comanda SC-3360 a fost deja expediată, deci nu pot modifica adresa.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: That new address is the one I need used.
